name: text-explode-scatter-out
title: Explode Scatter Out
description: Các ký tự nổ tung từ giữa ra, bay tứ tung, xoay tròn và mờ đi, kèm một vòng sóng nổ.

moworks.author: moworks

options.ring: [from, to] px of the burst ring ([30, 450])

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Codrops (MIT); a faithful port of Codrops' effects is in the Codrops collection

moworks.notes: Split chars; from the centre outward (stagger 10 ms; demo 15 ms capped 0.15 s), each char flies to a seeded random offset x ±300 px, y ±200 px (demo ×0.62 for its small stage), rotates ±180° and fades 1 → 0 (linear over the move), 0.8 s easeOutCubic (labelled power3.out), from 0.9 s. Demo adds an accent ring burst from the text centre: radius 6 → 90 px over 0.45 s outCubic, stroke 2 → 0.3 px. Loop: text fades back 2.4–2.9 s; loop 3 s. Params: spreadX / spreadY (±300 / ±200 px) · rotate (±180°) · duration (0.8 s) · stagger: từ giữa (0.01 s) · seed.
moworks.titleVi: Ký tự nổ tung, bay tứ tung
